key.name: move-workspace-left
key.summary: Move the workspace you are on one place to the left
key.description: Its windows and its name go with it, and it stops at the first place.

key.name: move-workspace-right
key.summary: Move the workspace you are on one place to the right
key.description: Its windows and its name go with it, and it stops at the last place.

key.name: auto-names
key.description: A workspace you have not named shows the name of the app with most windows on it, in a lighter type. A name you give it replaces that.

key.name: sets
key.summary: Saved sets in the workspace menu
key.description: Save a workspace's apps and their places, and open them again from the workspace menu. Turned off, the menu has no Sets, and the saved sets are kept for when it is on again.

key.name: resume
key.summary: Pick up where you left off after an update's restart
key.description: When an update restarts the computer, the apps that were open and their places are kept (app IDs and places only, never a title or a file), and the first session after it offers to open them again, once. ame desktop resume and Control write it.
